metadata.description: AI Loadout - a growing set of advanced AI marketing, sales, and automation skills and plug-ins for Claude Code. Build your loadout from copywriting, email sequences, social content, AI creative, Google Workspace, and commerce, all driven by natural-language conversation.

plugins.name: ac-builder
plugins.description: Build ActiveCampaign email sequences from markdown via MJML. Skills wrap the bundled ac-builder Python CLI for rendering, validation, V1 campaign creation, V3 click-action wiring, and theme-driven multi-brand workflows.

plugins.name: linkedin-post-studio
plugins.description: Profile-driven LinkedIn content generation: text posts, carousels, hooks, polls, video scripts, newsletters, calendars, companion comments, QA review, idea mining, and content repurposing.

plugins.name: creators-studio
plugins.description: AI image and video Creative Director powered by best-in-class models: Gemini Nano Banana, Kling v3, VEO 3.1, ElevenLabs, Lyria.

plugins.name: scribe
plugins.description: Google Workspace orchestration for Claude Code. Multi-account access to Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets, Slides, Contacts, Tasks, Forms, and Chat. Ships 14 cross-service workflow commands plus 10 service skills. Wraps taylorwilsdon/google_workspace_mcp.

plugins.name: spiffy
plugins.description: Talk to the Spiffy checkout platform from Claude Code. Customer lookup, MRR and affiliate and churn reports, customer notes, and one-off promo code generation. Works with any Spiffy account, just supply your own API key.

plugins.name: clickup
plugins.description: Talk to ClickUp from Claude Code. Token-disciplined task access and first-class bulk operations - deeper API coverage than the stock connector, gated single and bulk writes, and a large-job batch runner. Works with any ClickUp workspace, supply your own pk_ token.

plugins.name: vimeo
plugins.description: Push Descript exports from Google Drive into the existing Vimeo library. Multi-language captions and subtitles, title and description sync, and a gated destructive source-file replace, driven by a Google Sheet manifest read through the Scribe plugin. Bundles a Node MCP engine wrapping the official vimeo.js library.

plugins.name: descript
plugins.description: Full programmatic access to the Descript API - import media, Underlord AI agent edits, publish compositions, inspect jobs, and run bulk video pipelines. Node CLI wrapped by skills and an optional MCP shim. Supply your own Descript API token.

plugins.name: stripe
plugins.description: Full programmatic access to every Stripe API endpoint the pinned stripe-node SDK exposes, across many accounts (standalone keys and Stripe Connect). Binary-enforced read, mutating, and destructive safety tier with live-mode arming, read-only multi-account fan-out, and the bundled official Stripe CLI for webhooks. Node CLI wrapped by skills with an optional MCP shim. Replaces the single-account Stripe MCP connector. Supply your own Stripe keys.

plugins.name: epub-for-agents
plugins.description: Convert EPUBs to YAML-headed Markdown with per-chapter byte and line offsets so agents read books token-efficiently. Independent wrapper around prime-radiant-inc/books-for-bots. Requires the Rust toolchain (cargo).

plugins.name: wp-index
plugins.description: Extract and index any WordPress site through its REST API. Per-item Markdown, CSV, a JSON archive, and a Claude knowledge-base file. Standard-library Python, zero install. Any post type via a flag. Supply your own site URL and optional Application Password.

plugins.name: claude-seo
plugins.description: Comprehensive SEO analysis and on-page optimisation. Local SEO (Google Business Profile, citations, reviews, map pack), technical SEO, Schema.org generation, Core Web Vitals, AI search optimisation, sitemaps, and content quality across 25 sub-skills and 18 sub-agents. Fork of AgriciDaniel/claude-seo.

plugins.name: claude-blog
plugins.description: Full-lifecycle blog content engine. Strategy, briefs, SERP-informed outlines, writing, and 100-point quality scoring, dual-optimised for Google rankings and AI citations (GEO). Native output for Astro and WordPress, per-client brand and voice profiles, 12 content templates, and 30 sub-skills. Fork of AgriciDaniel/claude-blog.

plugins.name: pro-marketing-ads
plugins.description: Paid advertising audit and AI ad creative generation - 250+ checks across Google, Meta, YouTube, LinkedIn, TikTok, Microsoft, Apple, and Amazon Ads with weighted scoring, 12 industry templates, PPC math, A/B test design, and PDF reports. Ad image generation is handed to the creators-studio plugin (required). Fork of AgriciDaniel/claude-ads.

plugins.name: humanise-copy
plugins.description: Voice-preserving removal of the tell-tale signs of AI generation in written content. Two-tier detection (trigger phrases plus structural and rhythmic patterns), a zero-dependency Python detector with borderline warnings, a whitelist for brand signature phrases and deliberate technique, checks for the damage a repair pass itself introduces (telegraphese, converged tics, chop, orphaned pronouns), a read-aloud naturalness pass, and a ship or do-not-ship verdict gate. Structure that is search and answer-engine optimisation is routed to claude-seo rather than repaired.

plugins.name: impeccable
plugins.description: Design fluency for frontend development. One skill with 23 commands (/impeccable polish, audit, critique, distill, animate, bolder, quieter, and more), driven by a PRODUCT.md and DESIGN.md context flow and curated anti-pattern knowledge distilled from 60 deterministic detector rules. Third-party plugin by Paul Bakaus. Installing from the repo gives the skill form without hooks; the hook-driven detector, CLI, and browser extension live upstream at impeccable.style.

plugins.name: no-ai-slop
plugins.description: Remove 20+ patterns of AI slop from any piece of writing without flattening the writer's voice - binary contrasts, throat-clearing openers, colon reveals, importance puffery, weasel attribution, synonym cycling, and more - or detect slop patterns without rewriting. Fork of petergyang/no-ai-slop packaged as a Claude Code plugin, tracking upstream. Complements humanise-copy, which adds structural and rhythmic detection, repair-damage checks, and a ship or do-not-ship gate.

plugins.name: ui-ux-pro-max
plugins.description: UI/UX design intelligence. Searchable offline database of 84 UI styles, 192 colour palettes, 74 font pairings, 25 chart types, and UX guidelines across 22 stacks (React, Next.js, Astro, Vue, Svelte, SwiftUI, Flutter, Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Jetpack Compose, and more), plus companion skills for brand, design systems, slides, banner design, and UI styling. Third-party plugin by Next Level Builder. Fully offline core.
